**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The user is looking for suggestions on plants that can thrive in low-light conditions.  
[FACT] The user is considering adding plants to their bedroom to purify the air and create a calming atmosphere.  
[PREFERENCE] The user is interested in the Snake Plant and Peace Lily.  
[EVENT] The user is thinking of placing the Snake Plant on their nightstand and the Peace Lily on a shelf near the window.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended the following low-maintenance plants for low-light conditions:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Snake Plant (Sansevieria Trifasciata) - known for air purification and low maintenance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. ZZ Plant (Zamioculcas zamiifolia) - tolerates a range of lighting conditions and requires minimal watering.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Pothos (Epipremnum aureum) - versatile and can be trained to climb.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Peace Lily (Spathiphyllum wallisii) - produces white blooms and purifies air.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Dracaena (Dracaena spp.) - low-maintenance and air-purifying.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Philodendron (Philodendron spp.) - popular houseplant that thrives in low light.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Chinese Evergreen (Aglaonema commutatum) - known for beautiful, variegated leaves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Spider Plant (Chlorophytum comosum) - produces cute white blooms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Parlor Palm (Chamaedorea elegans) - adds tropical elegance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Bromeliad (Bromeliaceae family) - known for colorful blooms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised that even low-light plants benefit from some indirect sunlight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Snake Plant watering: water sparingly, allowing soil to dry out between waterings, and check soil moisture by sticking a finger into the soil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Peace Lily watering: prefer moist soil, check daily, and water when the top 1-2 inches feel dry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Both plants prefer well-draining soil and pots with good drainage holes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Snake Plants thrive in temperatures of 65°F to 75°F (18°C to 24°C) and avoid direct sunlight.
